evidence: Explicit out-of-band authority policy and finite exact operation ledger required; no default source
Pinned target/run/gate/subject/request/operation/source hash and transaction outcome correlation
Fresh finite-window completed transaction proof required; ambiguous, unknown, missing, timeout-only, stale and duplicate receipts rejected
Private file reader requires two bounded exact-ID files and adapter validation lineage
Existing reconciler refuses unvalidated JSON/verified flags; still requires independent exact-ID post-completion observation
Gate 4 deletion evidence is validated separately and remains refused by Gate 2 reconciler
limits: Policy source authenticity and transaction semantics require independent actual review; shapes and hashes alone are not authority
No raw Supabase provider exporter/parser or commit guarantee is invented
Deletion state confirmation and all cleanup remain separate Gate 4 operations
